thread:
marta: Quick check — we got the SKU mapping sheet from procurement. Does anyone know if we can map upcoming Dedicated reservations from H100-80GB -> H100-40GB fallback without breaking customer SLAs? Need to confirm before I approve the reservation swap.
shiv: We can, but perf will vary. H100-40GB has ~10-15% lower throughput for large context seqs. If customers require strict p99 latency, we should keep H100-80GB pinned.
alex: For the reservation manifest, mapping is a config change only: see snippet — ```sku_map: { H100-80: [H100-80, H100-40, A100-80], fallback_policy: zone_first }``` should be safe as long as we have reserved capacity in the same region.
tyler: FYI there's an open PR (https://git.internal/r/capacity-configs/pull/432) that updates the reservations to include the new fallback list. I pinged infra eng for review but it's waiting on @gordon for the region-affinity test.
gordon: Can take the test today. Blocker: one rack in us-west2 still showing degraded NVLINK topology after the firmware bump. I've scheduled a maintenance window 5pm PT to reflow cables and rerun diagnostics. If that fails we'll need to swap the node — ETA for swap is ~4 hours.
rachael: If the swap goes live we should update Customer X's reservation window. They accepted a soft degrade but want a heads-up. I can draft the outbound note once we know plan.
marta: Good. Two quick asks: (1) @tyler please merge the PR once @gordon confirms region tests, (2) @shiv can you run a short perf regression on the 40GB image with our 8k and 32k prompts and post the p50/p95? Preferably within 24h.
shiv: Will run. Quick run shows p95 up ~120ms on 8k, ~340ms on 32k for batch size 1. I'll run full sweep and post numbers.
ops-bot: Ticket #C-4421 created: "us-west2 NVLINK degraded rack — maintenance planned" — https://incidents.internal/t/C-4421 (assigned gordon).
alex: Also double-check the quota reservations UI — the customer-facing view still lists old SKU names. I opened a small follow-up PR to refresh labels.
tyler: Merged the label PR into staging. No impact to runtime.
gordon: Maintenance went as planned, reflow cleared topology, diagnostics green. Ran region-affinity tests, passed. Marking node healthy.
shiv: Full perf sweep done: 8k p50/p95: 22ms / 120ms, 32k p50/p95: 110ms / 340ms (batch=1). Quality regression: none observed on our eval prompts. Posting graphs to the capacity board.
marta: Thanks all. Action items: merge reservation PR (tyler) — owner: tyler, perf verification (shiv) — owner: shiv (done), customer comms draft (rachael) — owner: rachael, finalize reservation approval (marta). If we see >15% p95 uplift we'll revisit pinning.
rachael: Draft ready, will send after final confirmation.
marta: Approved to proceed with mapping and reservation swap for the us-west2 lot. Proceed with caution, keep me in loop. :thumbsup:
(emoji reactions: :eyes: to shiv's numbers, :rocket: from tyler)
